issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requests ID, Name, Art and URL of all Freibäder, but the solution query (aufgabe01.sql) selects only name, art and url (omitting the ID). This mismatch between the task description and the provided solution will confuse students about whether the ID column is required and may cause grading or test mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the artifacts consistent. Either update the solution query to include the ID column (e.g. SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad') so it matches the problem statement, or modify the problem statement to not require the ID. Preferably update solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql to select the ID as requested.
